fields.description: Issue features an investigative exposé of conditions and alleged mistreatment of mental patients at the Miami Retreat (7831 N. Miami Court), including a Miami Life photographer’s images and reporting by Gary Rogers. Also includes local political commentary on city/county matters and inflation, discussion of proposed changes to birth and death certificate confidentiality, coverage of Miami International Airport animal shipments involving Pan American World Airways, notes on state mental health training initiatives, labor news regarding the Miami Typographical Union strike/lockout, and additional Miami-area civic and social items and advertisements.
